audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Fling a W ('his W fling', 'Fling you (W)', 'before he Ws you over a wall') in six places. Fling is E (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s); W is Mega Adhesive. Also missing: Mega Adhesive GROUNDS, so glue under your feet denies Body Slam entirely, and a Fling that lands you in the glue ROOTS you.
audit.why: enemyKit E text: 'flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' W flags carry grounding. Grounding versus a dash is the decisive interaction in this lane and the page never states it.
audit.corrected: Fling is E on a 10s cooldown; Mega Adhesive is W, 17s at rank 1, and it grounds — never plan a Body Slam escape through the glue, and never get flung into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[] gives Singed levels 2, 3 and first item; the page's own whys say you win the level-2 trade, that level 3 is a coin-flip and that first item 'stays even'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill, Gragas, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Skill, Singed, and the mirror audit already flipped Level 2 and Level 6 to Gragas on Singed's page.
audit.corrected: Level 1 even, Level 2 Gragas, Level 3 even, Levels 4-5 even, Level 6 Gragas, first item even, two items Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was not credited as a Gragas spike in either chart, and the anti-heal direction is stated backwards on the page — it lists Executioner's Calling for you but never says HIS ultimate applies Grievous Wounds to you.
audit.why: enemyKit R: 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'. That cuts Happy Hour, which is the entire basis of the extended-trade advice from 6 onward.
audit.corrected: From 6, standing in his trail under Insanity Potion halves your Happy Hour sustain — trade in bursts, not grinds. Your Explosive Cask is 100s at rank 1, so it is a kill window, not a poke.

edits.after: Riftmaker burst hurts, but his Rod of Ages sustain keeps the first-item stage even.

edits.before: As the game goes long Singed reclaims this lane: he proxies your wave, runs you down with poison trail and W fling, and his stacked move speed makes your single Body Slam stun a non-threat since he walks out of range before you can re-engage. You stop being his 1v1 answer and become a teamfight tool, so use Explosive Cask to peel him off your carries and knock him out of your backline rather than dueling him in his trail. Do not facecheck or split alone into a fed Singed; his run-down kit is built to catch exactly your kind of short-range bruiser.
edits.after: As the game goes long Singed reclaims this lane: he proxies your wave, runs you down with Poison Trail and Fling (E), and drops Mega Adhesive (W) under you, which grounds Body Slam so you cannot dash out at all. Under Insanity Potion his trail also applies Grievous Wounds, so Happy Hour stops bailing you out. You become a teamfight tool: spend Explosive Cask peeling him off your carries rather than dueling in his trail. Do not split alone into a fed Singed; his run-down kit is built to catch a short-range bruiser.

notes: Six places on this page called Fling a W. Fling is E (10s) and W is Mega Adhesive (17s) — the slot error mattered because the two abilities combine: a Fling that lands you in the glue roots you, and glue under your feet grounds Body Slam so your escape simply does not cast. Both facts were absent and both are now on the page, matching what the mirror audit singed__gragas established. Also added the Grievous Wounds direction from Insanity Potion, which the page had backwards (it only ever discussed YOUR anti-heal). Charts on both layers now match packet.levelChart.
